title: Texture-Based Nesting | Clo 2025.0 Features Deep Dive
description:
The new update to our Nesting Features in 2025.0 allows you to easily nest your patterns based on your textures placements within the 3D window.  

Check out other new features here: https://www.clo3d.com/en/clo/features

Chapters: 
00:00 - Introduction
01:10 Where to find Nesting features
01:43 Regular Nesting 
02:26 Texture Based Nesting
07:24 Print Based Nesting 
08:35 Lock in Place Nesting 

Questions? Comment below or ask in our CLO discord server: https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/articles/7814962429977-How-can-I-join-CLO-Discord?utm_campaign=multi_item_banner_JointheOfficialCLODiscord&utm_medium=referral&utm_source=later-linkinbio
